d: The Jewish women come to the well. Rebekah, Esther, Sarah. They carry jugs, let down the bucket, fetch water.
Arsinoe comes from the Roman house, an amphora on her shoulder. The Jewish women look back a little, only the old Ruth remains close to the well.
The sun has risen higher, the dawn has evaporated. On the Peristyl appear, while Arsinoe descends, Arcesius and Myrtocle between the columns. Arcesius leads the blind with loving care to the stairs.
Aurelius Galba, the Roman Centurio, appears.
Arsinoe comes from the garden, in the arms a powerful basket, up top overloaded with many colorful flowers. She goes to Myrtocle.
